name: Managerial Communication
description: The course is designed to equip students with written and oral communication skills required both, as a student and a manager / leader. Students would learn effective nonverbal communication: metacommunication, role of body language and Impression management: relevance and tips. Students will practice presentation and writing skills. They would create messages in line with the changing landscape of business communication - impact of technology, diversity and ethical considerations.
